generate_attacks: generate a list of attacked images from a PIL image using rotation, blur, jpeg, and meme transformations
decode_0bit_from_folder: decode a zero-bit watermark from images in a folder using a neural net model and hypercone parameters
evaluate_0bit_on_attacks: evaluate zero-bit watermark detection scores across multiple image attacks like rotation, blur, and jpeg compression
decode_multibit_from_folder: decode a multi-bit watermark message from images in a folder using carrier vectors and a neural net model
evaluate_multibit_on_attacks: evaluate multi-bit watermark decoding accuracy across image attacks and compute bit and word accuracy metrics
